description: Source code implementing UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) context management and operations for the bbfdm API, including context initialization, cleanup, get/set configuration options, add/delete sections, and walk through sections.

methods.name: bbfdm_init_uci_ctx
methods.description: Initializes UCI context within the bbfdm context, allocating resources and setting configuration and save directories if provided.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get_buf
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI configuration value into a buffer, using package, section, and option identifiers, with fallback to default value.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get
methods.description: Gets a UCI configuration value as a string, duplicating the result.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get_fallback_def
methods.description: Gets a UCI configuration value with a default fallback, duplicating the result.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get_by_section_buf
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from a specific UCI section option into a buffer.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get_by_section
methods.description: Gets a string value from a UCI section option, duplicating the result.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_set
methods.description: Sets a UCI configuration option value.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_add
methods.description: Adds a new UCI section of a specified type to a package.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_delete
methods.description: Deletes a UCI entry specified by package, section, and option.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_commit_package
methods.description: Commits changes to a UCI package.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_walk_section
methods.description: Iterates over sections of a specific type within a package.
